evidence.directory: Public SDK cache, metadata covers both deployment-to-H intervals without gaps. Every event is independently verified in a successful transaction receipt, including block hash, log position, indexed pool, plugin and registry.
evidence.state: EIP-1898 requireCanonical=true at H, Multicall3 aggregate3. pool.factory(), plugin(), token0(), token1(), each registry.pluginByPool(pool), then factory.poolByPair(token0,token1) and configured customPoolByPair where present.
evidence.crosscheck: Six original pools cross-checked against homelander_base.json; identity of additional pools is not an execution, profit or liquidity measurement.
evidence.pool_state: EIP-1898 tag, Multicall3 aggregate3: liquidity() -> uint128 in-range units, globalState() -> (uint160 sqrtPriceX96,int24 tick,uint16 lastFee,uint8 pluginConfig,uint16 communityFee,bool unlocked). unlocked reports a pool lock bit at this block; the ABI does not expose a separate pause switch.

quickswap_plugin.description: For each pool: listed active plugin in pinned factory; historical plugin runtime with its exact 32-byte pool immutable at offset zeroed for template hash; historical EIP-1967 beacon storage and current implementation at the configured beacon. These checks are required but do not measure swap output.
